title: 按键绑定与设备支持不佳
description: 按键绑定不合理、缺乏自定义选项，手柄、Steam Deck等设备支持不佳，影响控制体验。
evidence: traditional controller support is not that great.
move the hotkeys for thrust forward and backward to Q and E
it switches to gamepad mode even you have gamepad turned off

evidence_items.quote: Insufficient controll settings in general: not being able to selectively set power levels for directional and rotational thrust is fine in the beginning when everything is super slow, but man does it suck when you pilot your 50 ton custom freighter through the venusian atmosphere and the shortest of cklicks for a tiny course correction sends you spinning to your death becaus you did not revert to 1x speed on your flight that takes 5 real time minutes even on 16x speed.
evidence_items.description: 控制设置不足，无法选择性设置方向推进和旋转推进的功率级别
evidence_items.quote_zh: 总体上控制设置不足：无法选择性地为方向推进和旋转推进设置功率水平，在一开始一切都超级慢的时候还好，但当你在金星大气层中驾驶你那50吨的定制货船时，那感觉真是糟透了，为了做一次微小的航向修正而最短的一次点击就会让你旋转着送命，因为在你那趟即使16倍速也要花5分钟真实时间的飞行中，你没有切回1倍速。

evidence_items.quote: traditional controller support is not that great.
evidence_items.quote_zh: 传统手柄支持就没那么好了。

evidence_items.quote: on Steam Deck the controls and performance are very poor
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在Steam Deck上，操控和性能都非常糟糕

evidence_items.quote: if I right-click, there’s a list of what I can do—but if the interaction is via right-click, why bother doing it with the left mouse button too?
evidence_items.description: 右键有操作列表，左键也能执行相同操作，令人困惑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果我右键点击，会有一个我能做什么的列表——但如果交互是通过右键点击进行的，那为什么还要用左键点击也做同样的事呢？

evidence_items.quote: turning the keyboard into a piano where four actions are crammed onto a single button
evidence_items.description: 键盘按键被塞入过多操作，像弹钢琴
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把键盘变成一架钢琴，四个动作挤在一个按键上

evidence_items.quote: If your cursor disappears while using the controller
evidence_items.description: 使用手柄时鼠标指针消失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你在使用控制器时鼠标光标消失了

evidence_items.quote: it switches to gamepad mode even you have gamepad turned off
evidence_items.description: 即使关闭手柄仍切换到手柄模式
evidence_items.quote_zh: 即使你关闭了手柄，它也会切换到手柄模式

evidence_items.quote: a few things still feel like they want a mouse and keyboard
evidence_items.description: 手柄布局部分操作仍需键鼠
evidence_items.quote_zh: 但有几样东西仍然感觉需要鼠标和键盘

evidence_items.quote: seria genial poder moverte usando teclas(WASD)en lugar del mouse
evidence_items.description: 只能用鼠标移动，希望支持WASD键盘移动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果能用按键（WASD）而不是鼠标来移动，那就太好了

evidence_items.quote: Just make it WASD like every other game please.
evidence_items.description: 控制方式不是WASD，玩家不喜欢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 请把它做成像其他所有游戏一样的WASD吧。

evidence_items.quote: Default command keys are bizarre.  Tab should be switching between crew.  CAPS LOCK is a strange choice
evidence_items.description: 默认按键设置奇怪，切换船员用Caps Lock而非Tab
evidence_items.quote_zh: 默认命令键很奇怪。Tab应该用于切换船员。CAPS LOCK是个奇怪的选择

evidence_items.quote: Some people might get annoyed of the controls/lack of keybinds/UI
evidence_items.description: 控制方式缺乏按键绑定。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些人可能会对操作/缺少按键绑定/UI感到恼火

evidence_items.quote: move the hotkeys for thrust forward and backward to Q and E
evidence_items.description: 希望将前后推进热键改为Q和E
evidence_items.quote_zh: 把向前和向后推进的快捷键移到Q和E

evidence_items.quote: on Steam Deck the controls and performance are very poor
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在Steam Deck上，操控和性能都非常糟糕

evidence_items.quote: traditional controller support is not that great.
evidence_items.quote_zh: 传统手柄支持就没那么好了。
